realHardware.note: operator timing can only be measured by observing a real, non-developer operator use CIP on a real target machine with real hardware. No such operator, machine, or hardware is available in this session. Nothing in this field has been estimated, simulated, or inferred - all values are explicitly null rather than guessed.

automated.note: operator-facing timing is a human-in-the-loop, real-hardware measurement by definition; there is no automated or Xvfb equivalent that would be meaningful evidence of it
